_README: Edit decision list for the LMNOP split-screen recut.
STATUS OF THE TIMINGS BELOW: the segment in/out points are a STRUCTURAL
TEMPLATE, not a transcript-derived cut. The source videos live on Meta's
CDN (video.xx.fbcdn.net), which this environment's egress policy blocks,
so the footage could not be viewed or transcribed. Every 'start'/'end'
below is marked needs_confirm and must be checked against the real
The caption copy IS real -- it is lifted from the live creative for
Total spoken runtime as written: 30.0s. The source is 35.3s, so the
recut buys its pace by cutting ~5.3s of slack out of her delivery --
that is the whole point of the exercise, per the brief.

lmnop._crop_anchor_note: 0=keep top of frame, 1=keep bottom. 0.35 biases toward her face; retune once the footage is visible.

layout._split_note: Share of the 1920px canvas given to the top (foam) panel. 0.5 = the even split in the brief.

caption_style._margin_note: 300px clears the Reels/TikTok bottom UI so captions are never covered.

lmnop_segments._beat: HOOK - her strongest cold-open line. Must earn the scroll-stop in 3s.
lmnop_segments.caption: I stopped fighting my kid at bath time.

lmnop_segments.caption: Regular soap left his skin dry and itchy.
